scenario: I work in customer service for a well-known retail giant. Today, a woman cut in front of the line, yelling at me that her Visa gift card, which was supposed to have $250, showed that it had no money on it. I told her there was nothing we could do, as Visa gift cards were out of our hands. I called a manager over to see if they had a possible solution. The woman kept shouting to my manager, saying that the cashier lied to her about it being active right away. I gathered from the ongoing conversation that the reason she was so desperate for this money was that she needed to pay an electricity bill for her apartment that was due today, but had no other money. Suddenly, it made sense why she was so frantic. She commented in a distressed tone, saying, “I wouldn't do this if I didn't need to!” If I steal a gift card from the store's supply, then the woman will be able to pay her bill. If I do not do this, she will go without electricity for the month.
entities: i,the woman with the visa gift card,the manager,the cashier who sold or discussed the gift card,other customers waiting in line
outcomes: The woman remains unable to pay her electricity bill today
The woman remains distressed and upset
The woman does not receive $250 from the store
The store keeps its gift card inventory
I avoid stealing from the store
I avoid immediate disciplinary and legal consequences for theft
The woman goes without electricity for the month
